action.new_text:
# Validate inputs
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative scalar")
    
    for mat, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if mat.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if mat.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(mat)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(mat > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("Matrices must have the same shape")
    
    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw / raw.sum()
    
    # Compute weighted losses (negative weighted log probabilities)
    L_plus = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    
    # Compute L_minus as min of no_call and call_only
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
    
    margins = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margins >= tau_filter
    
    return keep.astype(np.bool_), margins.astype(np.float64)
